6a04b54fee995153b15a3e70 description:
We have seen you from afar, and now seen you in the flesh.

You will help us, and we will help you, yes?

6a04b6d9ee995153b15a3e7b description:
You see... the Eye is always looking for new Strugglers to complete his will. Complete the tasks laid bare and maybe the Eye will give you the aid you seek. 

In the forests of Tarkov there is a meeting place for candidates like yourself. It lies off the path used by the machines of 'man'. A gateway into a yard of lumber.

6a07ab808ff25d06e48d31e8 description:

Find the keyholder and TAKE HIS PLACE.
